app.name: Aivanta
app.synthetic_banner: Synthetic demonstration data. Every figure is generated by a reproducible model and does not describe a real company.

login.title: Sign in to Aivanta
login.subtitle: Measure whether your AI investment pays for itself.
login.demo_hint: All demo accounts use the password set in AIVANTA_DEMO_PASSWORD (default: aivanta-demo).
login.role_finance: Finance — edits assumptions and freezes ROI snapshots

onboarding.title: Welcome to Aivanta
onboarding.intro: Aivanta answers one question: are you getting more value from AI than you spend on it?
onboarding.step_spend_body: Every model call is priced from versioned price schedules and allocated to a department and use case. Usage nobody can attribute stays visibly unallocated.
onboarding.step_outcomes_body: Benefits only count towards ROI when they are verified against the ledger or supported by a controlled measurement. Estimates are shown, but never mixed in.
onboarding.step_value_body: ROI, payback and AI-versus-human comparisons come with sample sizes and intervals. When the evidence is too thin, Aivanta says so instead of inventing a number.

basis.measured_help: Computed directly from usage or task records.
basis.evidence_backed_help: Built only from benefits verified against the ledger or supported by a controlled measurement.
basis.estimated_help: Modelled from assumptions. Never included in ROI.

filters.title: Filters
filters.roi_not_applicable: ROI is not calculated when filtering by provider or model: business benefits cannot be split by model. Spend and usage figures still apply.

ai_spend.label: AI spend (models & API)
ai_spend.definition: Sum of the cost of every usage event in the period. Cost = uncached input × input price + cached input × cached price + output × output price, using the price in force on the day of the call.

total_ai_cost.label: Total AI-related cost
total_ai_cost.definition: Model & API usage + subscriptions + infrastructure + implementation + maintenance + incremental human review and rework. This is the denominator of ROI.

input_tokens.label: Input tokens
input_tokens.definition: Prompt tokens sent to models, including tokens served from the provider's cache.

output_tokens.label: Output tokens
output_tokens.definition: Tokens generated by models, including reasoning tokens where the provider bills them as output.

cached_input_tokens.label: Cached input tokens
cached_input_tokens.definition: Share of input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache, billed at a reduced rate.

active_users.label: Active users
active_users.definition: Distinct people with at least one attributed AI request in the period.

active_departments.label: Active departments
active_departments.definition: Departments with at least one attributed AI request in the period.

error_rate.label: Error rate
error_rate.definition: Usage records that ended in an error, divided by all usage records.

gross_benefit.label: Gross benefit
gross_benefit.definition: Verified financial savings + supported incremental contribution + supported cost avoidance. Claims describing the same outcome are counted once.

estimated_total_value.label: Estimated business value
estimated_total_value.definition: Gross benefit plus estimated claims and the labour value of hours saved. An estimate for context only; it never enters ROI.

roi.label: Return on investment (ROI)
roi.definition: (Gross benefit − total AI-related cost) ÷ total AI-related cost × 100. Shown only when the evidence threshold is met.

verified_savings.label: Verified financial savings
verified_savings.definition: Savings reconciled to the general ledger or supplier invoices.

hours_saved.label: Time saved
hours_saved.definition: AI-assisted tasks × (baseline minutes − AI minutes) ÷ 60, against a concurrent control group or a documented baseline. Reported separately from cash.

cost_per_successful_task.label: Cost per successful task
cost_per_successful_task.definition: Total AI-related cost ÷ AI-assisted tasks completed successfully.

benefit_cost_ratio.label: Benefit-to-cost ratio
benefit_cost_ratio.definition: Gross benefit ÷ total AI-related cost. Above 1.0 means benefits exceed costs.

payback.label: Payback period
payback.definition: One-off investment ÷ monthly net run-rate (monthly gross benefit − monthly recurring cost). Empty when the run-rate is not positive.

break_even.label: Break-even volume
break_even.definition: Successful tasks needed for gross benefit to cover all costs, assuming benefit and variable cost scale per task and fixed costs do not.

adoption.label: AI adoption
adoption.definition: Weekly active users ÷ people in scope.

budget_utilization.label: Budget utilisation
budget_utilization.definition: Month-to-date model & API spend ÷ monthly budget. Forecast = month-to-date spend + trailing 14-day average daily spend × remaining days.

dashboard.title: Executive overview
dashboard.subtitle: Are we getting more value from AI than we are spending on it?
dashboard.verdict_positive: AI returned {roi} on its total cost in this period.
dashboard.verdict_negative: AI did not pay for itself in this period: ROI {roi}.
dashboard.verdict_partial: Some use cases do not have enough evidence yet and contribute costs but no benefits: {list}.
dashboard.verdict_insufficient: There is not enough evidence to calculate ROI for this selection.
dashboard.spend_trend_desc: Model & API cost per day. Highlighted points are statistical anomalies (more than 3 standard deviations above the mean).
dashboard.adoption_trend_desc: Share of people in scope who used AI at least once in the week.
dashboard.budgets_desc: Model & API spend against monthly budgets, as of {date}.
dashboard.roi_bridge_desc: Evidence-backed benefits against every AI-related cost category.
dashboard.scenarios_desc: Conservative applies a haircut to supported benefits and a cost contingency; optimistic adds part of the estimates.

costs.title: Usage & costs
costs.subtitle: Where AI spend goes, by provider, model, department and use case.
costs.pricing_desc: Prices per million tokens. Demo models and prices are illustrative, not vendor list prices.

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Usage, cost, outcomes and ROI by department. Organisation-wide shared costs are not allocated to departments.
departments.unallocated_note: Usage without a known department is kept separate rather than guessed.

outcomes.title: Business outcomes
outcomes.subtitle: What each use case delivers, how it is measured and how much of it counts towards ROI.
outcomes.no_benefits_counted: No benefit meets the evidence rules yet.
outcomes.causal_yes: Causal design: differences can be attributed to AI.
outcomes.causal_no: Correlational design: differences cannot be attributed to AI on their own.

comparison.title: AI vs. non-AI
comparison.subtitle: AI-assisted work compared with the same work done without AI. AI is never assumed to be better.
comparison.total_minutes: Minutes per task (incl. review and rework)
comparison.net_benefit_estimate_help: Per-task cost difference × AI tasks completed. Uses the labour cost assumption, so it is an estimate.
comparison.forest: Time per task: AI minus non-AI
comparison.forest_desc: Points left of zero mean AI is faster. Bars show 95% intervals; when a bar crosses zero the difference is not statistically clear.
comparison.no_data: No non-AI tasks were recorded, so no comparison is possible.

recommendations.title: Recommendations & alerts
recommendations.subtitle: Rule-based and explainable: each item shows the metrics that triggered it. Projected savings are estimates.

data.title: Data & ingestion
data.subtitle: Load usage exports. Records that cannot be attributed are kept as unallocated.
data.live_sync_status: Not implemented — load exported files instead.
data.samples: Sample files for every format are in the repository's samples/ folder.
data.snapshots_desc: Freeze the current ROI so a reported figure can be reproduced later.

settings.title: ROI assumptions
settings.subtitle: Thresholds and scenario parameters used by every calculation. Changes are audited.
settings.read_only: Only Finance and Administrators can change assumptions.
settings.saved: Assumptions saved. All figures have been recalculated.
settings.min_sample_size: Minimum AI-assisted tasks for an ROI figure
settings.conservative_benefit_haircut: Conservative scenario: haircut on supported benefits
settings.optimistic_estimated_benefit_share: Optimistic scenario: share of estimates included

decision.selective: Use AI only for selected task types
decision.stop: Stop using AI for this workflow

decision_help.continue: Measured value is positive and the evidence supports it.
decision_help.optimize: AI helps, but its cost is not yet justified. Reduce cost or improve the workflow.
decision_help.selective: AI works for some task types and hurts others.
decision_help.experiment: The evidence is inconclusive. Measure against a control group before deciding.
decision_help.stop: Measured costs or quality losses outweigh the benefits.

reason.no_supported_benefits: No benefit is verified or supported by a controlled measurement.
reason.sample_too_small: Too few tasks have been measured.
reason.period_too_short: The measurement period is too short.
reason.no_outcome_data: No outcome data has been recorded.
reason.partial_evidence: Some use cases contribute costs but no evidenced benefits yet.
reason.quality_declined: Quality is significantly lower with AI.
reason.costs_or_quality_outweigh_benefits: Costs or quality losses outweigh the benefits.
reason.cheaper_but_lower_quality: Cheaper with AI, but quality is lower.
reason.association_only: The design shows association, not causation.
reason.benefits_not_yet_evidenced: Cheaper per task, but benefits are not yet evidenced.
reason.no_time_or_cost_advantage: No time or cost advantage over the non-AI process.
reason.cost_exceeds_value: Cost per completed task is higher than without AI.
reason.roi_not_positive: Cheaper per task, but total ROI is not positive.

exclusion.duplicate_evidence: Duplicate of a stronger claim on the same outcome
exclusion.savings_not_verified: Savings must be verified against the ledger

budget_exceeded.title: {scope} has exceeded its monthly budget
budget_exceeded.body: Model and API spend is above the budget for the month. Review high-cost use cases or adjust the budget.

budget_forecast_exceeds.title: {scope} is forecast to exceed its budget
budget_forecast_exceeds.body: At the current daily run-rate, spend will pass the budget before the month ends.

budget_warning.title: {scope} is approaching its budget
budget_warning.body: Month-to-date spend has passed the warning threshold.

expansion_candidate.title: {scope} is a candidate for expansion
expansion_candidate.body: Measured ROI is positive with a causal design and no loss in quality. Consider extending it to more teams.

stop_workflow.title: Consider stopping AI for {scope}
stop_workflow.body: Measured costs or quality trade-offs outweigh the benefits.

restrict_to_task_types.title: Restrict {scope} to the task types where it works
restrict_to_task_types.body: AI is faster but quality drops for some task types. Keep it where results hold up.

spend_without_improvement.title: {scope} is spending more without better outcomes
spend_without_improvement.body: Spend grew over the last 30 days while success rate and quality did not improve.

cheaper_model.title: A lower-cost model may be enough for {scope}
cheaper_model.body: This is a simple task running on a frontier model. Validate a cheaper model on a sample before switching.

high_tokens_low_quality.title: {scope} uses many tokens for low-quality results
high_tokens_low_quality.body: Tokens per task are above the organisation median while quality is below the acceptable floor. Review prompts and context size.

review_erasing_gains.title: Human review is erasing the time saved in {scope}
review_erasing_gains.body: Extra review and rework consume most of the minutes AI saves.

unallocated_usage.title: Part of AI spend cannot be attributed
unallocated_usage.body: Usage without a department or use case weakens ROI analysis. Map the API keys or projects responsible.

needs_outcome_tracking.title: {scope} needs better outcome tracking
needs_outcome_tracking.body: It generates cost, but there is not enough evidence of benefits to calculate ROI.

spend_anomaly.title: Unusual spend on {scope}
spend_anomaly.body: Daily spend was far above the usual level. Check for runaway loops or retries.

rec_metric.same_token_volume_and_quality_to_be_vali: Same token volume; quality must be validated

error.title: Something went wrong
error.invalid_token: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.forbidden: Your role does not have permission for this action.
error.invalid_filters: The filters are not valid. Check the dates.
error.invalid_assumption: One of the values is out of range.
error.ingestion_failed: The file could not be read in this format.
error.file_too_large: The file is too large (maximum 20 MB).
error.file_not_utf8: The file must be UTF-8 encoded.
error.network: Cannot reach the Aivanta API. Check that the backend is running.

empty.title: No data for this selection
empty.body: Widen the date range or clear some filters.
